scientific_integrity: The proof derives the arbitrary-length matrix law from a verified standard nilpotent-count theorem and an exact expected-kernel identity, then applies radical reduction and Wedderburn decomposition. Finite exact computations verify selected cases, not all universals. Originality comparisons distinguish the two-factor and field-only prior special cases; independent audit remains unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Does not address nonunital/infinite rings, nonuniform or dependent factors, nilpotency-index distribution, or full matrix-product distributions. Supporting older sources are used only for standard theorems; the motivating recent primary source is arXiv:2504.12886, first public 2025-04-17, primary MSC2020 16P10.
scientific_scope: Exact nilpotent-product probability for every positive number of independently uniform factors in every finite associative unital ring; parameterized by the simple factors of its semisimple quotient.
title: Exact \(k\)-fold nilpotent-product law for finite rings
